snippet.title: S.O.V.A. Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5240650/SOVA

S.O.V.A. is a first-person psychological horror game set between present-day Serbia and a secret Yugoslav military facility from the 1980s.

After discovering a cassette hidden by his late grandfather, Marko uncovers S.O.V.A., a classified military system created to predict wars, disasters and other major events.

But what if it wasn't only predicting the future?

Developed by Black Cape Games, an independent game studio.

#SOVA #HorrorGames #IndieGames
